The '''Thuldin's Grant sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was adjacent to the [[Trailing Grant sector/Legends|Trailing Grant sector]] and the [[Montitian Grant sector/Legends|Montitian Grant sector]], as well as the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|Freestanding subsectors]] of the Expansion Region and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The sector included the [[Garen system/Legends|Garen system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] where the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]] was located.<ref name="EAOC" />

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] containing the sector was first explored between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Garen IV was the location of a [[Garen IV penal colony|penal colony]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], although<ref name="FAJ8" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Firepower]]" places the [[Raid on Garen IV|raid]] on [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]] five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before its main story, which is set in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] carried out a [[Raid on Garen IV|raid]] there and freed a number of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="FAJ8" /> By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the average population of the area was less than one million [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings per star system. The entire sector was considered part of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|galactic empire]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]] by [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thuldin's Grant sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the StarWars.com article [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region] on [[October 26]], [[2012]]. The map placed it across grid squares J-15 and K-15.<ref name="ExpansionRegion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref>
